annotations.title: What will I owe this year

description: This tax year's income tax, Class 4 NI and High Income Child Benefit Charge on pay, self-employment, rent, interest and dividends, less what PAYE has taken - whether a Self Assessment bill is coming, how much, whether a return is needed, and next year's payments on account. Use for 'will I have a tax bill this year' or 'do I need to do a tax return'.

childBenefitChildren.description: Children Child Benefit is claimed for. Defaults to 0.

dividends.description: Dividends outside ISAs and pensions. Defaults to 0.

payeIncome.description: Pay, bonus, taxable benefits and pension taxed through PAYE, in pounds a year. Defaults to 0.

payeTaxPaid.description: Income tax PAYE has taken for the year. Left out: worked out as the right tax on that pay alone.

paymentsOnAccountMade.description: Payments on account already made towards this year. Defaults to 0.

rentalMortgageInterest.description: Mortgage interest on let property. Defaults to 0.

rentalProfit.description: Rental profit after running costs, before mortgage interest. Defaults to 0.

savingsInterest.description: Savings interest outside ISAs. Defaults to 0.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

selfEmployedProfit.description: Sole trader profit after expenses. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_year_tax_owed
title: What will I owe this year
